core_obligations: (1) <=> fully faithful: accepted restrict lemma; assume (1) and ff.

Assume (2): given x' locally from a' in U'(T) (stackification fact), lift a' fppf-locally along h by pr_0 b_i, and pr_1 b_i in R'(T_i) gives the isomorphism f(a_i) = a'|_{T_i}; hence ess. surj (Stacks characterization cited).

Assume equivalence: apply the Stacks lemma to xi' = image of id_{U'}; covering refinement twice yields (a_i, r'_i) with h(a_i, r'_i) = g'_i; hence h refines a covering and is a sheaf-surjection (citation).
Residual cases (h an fppf covering; f sheaf-surjective with s having a section e) by citation.
proof_roadmap: accepted-lemma reduction + complete covering-descent arguments both ways.
difficulty_reason: Complete two-direction argument: (1)<=>ff via the accepted restrict lemma; under (1), equivalence iff h is a sheaf-surjection, with both directions argued by covering descent and explicit lifting data.
